note: Decision 10a: baseCost is the original April-2010 snapshot (25/90/225/1,781/14,145), taken as the level-1 price. Actual cost = baseCost * (1 + economy.shiftCostScaling.perLevel * (level - 1)); the original documented costs rising with level. Staff wages and upkeep are zeroed (see staff.json / economy.json) so the shown price IS the table; a per-worker component returns with the temp-staff model in the mechanics phase.
graceNote: Decision 5a: the original closed hard at the end of a shift, so there is no grace window. The field stays for the schema; 0 means endsAtTick and graceEndsAtTick coincide.
tuningNote: Decision 9a: per-shift incomeMultiplier removed (all 1.0) — not in the original. The long-shift dominance it patched is now priced away by the original table itself: 48h costs 566x the 2h shift.
